profile_text.body:
Symbotic Inc. is a public company, traded under the ticker SYM, with CIK 0001837240 and headquarters in Wilmington, MA. Its website describes it as a provider of end-to-end warehouse automation for retailers and distributors, built around robotic systems and software that move goods through the supply chain. The company says its systems use dense storage to increase facility capacity and streamlined operations to raise throughput, and that its solutions can be adapted to industries handling palletized goods, small quantity fulfillment, or omnichannel operations. It states that goods from 1 lb (0.5 kg) and 2 x 6.4 x 5 in (5.1 x 16.3 x 12.7 cm) up to 60 lb (27.2 kg) and 36 x 24 x 16.2 in (91.4 x 61 x 41.2 cm) can be managed and fulfilled in their native packaging, and that loose items with cold chain requirements also have automation options.

On AI, the company describes itself as leading the advent of AI software that expands operational possibilities, and as providing AI-enhanced software that sees beyond warehouse walls. It presents itself as the software and key robotic innovator for each solution it sells, contrasting this with integrators it says are limited by technology partnerships. It also describes itself as the leader in industrial automation and in technology at large, and states its purpose as getting the right goods to people who need them when they need them.

The record lists no lawsuits involving the company. Massachusetts is the state associated with its litigation exposure, with a count of 191. No products and no MCP servers are listed for it.
